tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Handheld screen and desk page background. Always white on stations, for glare and the projector. Product value, unchanged.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Rows, cards on desk screens, the shelf code plate, quiet button hover. Product value, unchanged.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control (use ink-2 for input borders). Product value, unchanged.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Graphite ground of the front page, the demo stage and the device frame. Proposed: neutral instead of the slate #0f172a so the lime reads clean. Every on-dark token below is checked against it.

tokens.name: frame-2
tokens.usage: Raised panels on frame: the loop card on the front page, back-office panels on the demo stage.

tokens.name: line-on-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and the idle loop track on frame. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Untinted dark surface behind every photo and the live camera. Fixed by the product: never tint it, never put the brand on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface and surface-2 (17.7:1). Fill of the station primary button, the grade badge and the push-to-talk button. Focus ring on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface (7.6:1) and surface-2 (7.3:1). Input borders and the dashed proposal outline.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on frame (18:1), frame-2 and stage.

tokens.name: ink-2-on-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary text on frame (7.6:1) and frame-2 (6.9:1): the English line of the front page, caption translations on the demo stage. Proposed neutral grey to match frame (was #94a3b8).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Verdict green: fill of the ok verdict banner (white on it 5.0:1), text and icon of ok chips. Means only: matches, done. Fixed by the product.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of ok chips and ok rows (ok on it 4.8:1). Fixed.

tokens.name: ok-strong-bg
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected ok row. Fixed.

tokens.name: ok-on-dark
tokens.usage: Ok text and icons on frame (10.8:1) and stage. Bounding box for a present item. Fixed.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Verdict amber: fill of the warn verdict banner (white on it 5.0:1), border and icon of the pack-alert and cost-limit banners. Means only: needs an action. Fixed.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning banners and warn chips (warn on it 4.8:1). Fixed.

tokens.name: warn-strong-bg
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected warn row. Fixed.

tokens.name: warn-on-dark
tokens.usage: Warn text and icons on frame (11.3:1). Fixed.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Verdict red: fill of the stop verdict banner (white on it 6.5:1), the destructive button, the dashed outline of a missing line. Means only: stop. Fixed.

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of stop chips and error banners (stop on it 5.9:1). Fixed.

tokens.name: stop-strong-bg
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected stop row. Fixed.

tokens.name: stop-on-dark
tokens.usage: Stop text and icons on frame (6.8:1). Bounding box for an unexpected item. Fixed.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hi-vis lime. Only on frame and frame-2 (16:1 against frame): the mark tile, the primary button on dark pages, the travelling highlight on the loop, the voice orb on the demo stage. Never on a white station screen, never as text on white (1.2:1), never on stage.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a brand fill (16:1). Use it, never white, on lime.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the lime button on dark pages (brand-ink on it 13:1).

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Lime-tinted ground on frame: the active node of the loop, the selected scene in the director bar. ink-on-dark on it 12.7:1, brand on it 11.3:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on surface and surface-2: 3px solid, 2px offset (17.7:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring on frame and frame-2: 3px solid lime, 2px offset (16:1).

tokens.name: box-present
tokens.usage: Solid 4px bounding box around an item that is in the order.

tokens.name: box-unexpected
tokens.usage: Solid 4px bounding box around an item that is not in the order.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The verdict word in a verdict banner. Never below 28px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Legg alle varene i esken og trykk Sjekk.
styles.usage: Instructions and body copy on the handheld. The minimum size there.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, field labels on the handheld.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Stop. The order says a navy hoodie.
styles.usage: Caption translations and header chips only. Never an instruction.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Hver vare sjekket, på vei ut og på vei tilbake.
styles.usage: Front page headline at 1440. Step down to 44px at 1024 and 34px on a phone.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every item checked on the way out and on the way back.
styles.usage: The English line under a Norwegian headline, and the one-sentence how.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark. 18px in the handheld header.

styles.name: desk-title
styles.usage: Panel titles on lead, insights and admin.

styles.name: dense
styles.sample: Kunden fikk størrelse M i stedet for L.
styles.usage: Tables and body on lead and admin screens.

styles.name: dense-strong
styles.usage: Column headers, card eyebrows and desk buttons.

styles.name: shelf
styles.usage: Shelf code on the decision screen. Never below 64px.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: Order and return numbers as row titles.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SKUs, NOK amounts, confidence and times on the handheld.

styles.name: code-dense
styles.usage: SKUs, amounts and times in desk tables and JSON blocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and rows, between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Handheld gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks on a station screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desk panel padding, front page column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Front page outer margin at 1024 and up.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags on bounding boxes, inputs on desk.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners, the shelf plate, the grade badge.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the photo stage, the verdict banner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The device frame on the demo stage and front page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Language chip, voice orb, loop nodes.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: The handheld frame on the demo stage. The only large shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Desk cards and the lightbox. Station screens use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: target-handheld
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any tap target on the handheld.

tokens.name: target-desk
tokens.usage: Minimum height of tap targets on lead and admin screens.

tokens.name: gutter-handheld
tokens.usage: Side gutter on the handheld.

tokens.name: box-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of bounding boxes on photos.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Handheld body minimum.

tokens.name: text-dense
tokens.usage: Lead and admin tables.

tokens.name: text-verdict
tokens.usage: Minimum for a verdict word.

tokens.name: text-shelf
tokens.usage: Minimum for the shelf code on the decision screen.

tokens.name: numeric
tokens.usage: font-variant-numeric for any figure set in the sans (counts, «1 av 2»).

duration.note: Motion is short and never decorative on a station. Under prefers-reduced-motion everything is instant and the loop highlight stands still on the active node.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Button press, chip toggle.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Verdict banner fade-in, banner open.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One lap of the highlight around the front page loop.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters.
